newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: UNIVAR SECOND QUARTER RESULTS RISE 55 PCT.
newsitem.headline: UNIVAR SECOND QUARTER RESULTS RISE 55 PCT.

text.p: Univar , which will be de-listed from the New York Stock Exchange today, said on Tuesday that its second quarter results, ending August 31, improved to 6.7 million dollars from 4.3 million in the same period a year earlier.
Earnings per share rose to 0.31 dollar from 0.20 dollar.
Univar is no longer a publicly held corporation, its financial results will not be reported independently in the future, it said in a statement.
Results will be consolidated with the financial results of its parent, Royal Pakhoed NV.
Dutch tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed said earlier it had upped its stake in Univar to 100 percent from 95.5 percent. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
